subject: Trading
title: What Is a Market Crash?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is a Market Crash?.

hook.text: A market crash is a sudden, violent drop of 20% or more—often in days. Decades of gains can vanish in hours.

buildup.text: Crashes differ from corrections (10% dips) in speed and severity. They trigger panic, margin calls, and forced selling.

discovery.text: The average bear market falls 36% and lasts 289 days. But crashes—the acute phase—often happen in just weeks.

twist.text: Crashes feel like the end of the world. In reality, every crash in U.S. history was followed by full recovery.

climax.text: Understanding crash mechanics doesn't prevent fear—but it lets you act rationally when everyone else can't.

quiz.question: What defines a market crash?
options: A sudden violent drop of 20% or more in a short period
